versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Karpathy Principles skill as a pre-implementation quality gate.
- Introduces four core principles: think-first, simplicity, surgical edits, and verifiable goals.
- Provides guidance and checklists to reduce common LLM and coding pitfalls before shipping code.
- Includes references to supporting skills and modules for deeper dives and practical self-checks.
- Defines concrete exit criteria and required pre-flight artifacts to ensure rigorous implementation habits.
